mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate stronger residential construction activity, which typically signals robust consumer spending and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above its 1-year moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points over the past month indicates accelerating labor market strength, which typically precedes higher corporate earnings and positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE falls by more than 0.2pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and decreases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a robust economic expansion, which typically drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 100 and UNRATE < 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 250), higher housing starts (HOUST) predict positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as low inflation supports real estate investment and consumer spending.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL < 250, HOUST is above its 1-year average but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an ultra-loose monetary policy, which typically compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates elevated inflation, which typically erodes corporate profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above its 1-year moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 indicates strong manufacturing activity, which typically signals robust corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a resilient labor market that can absorb higher rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 3 months and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 3 months and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 1 month.
